Learning/experimentation repo for Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), with PM Copilot and docs/examples.

```sh
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env  # then fill in OPENAI_API_KEY at minimum
python app.py --console
python app.py --server
python app.py --devui
python app.py --copilotkit
cd maf_copilotkit/agent
uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000
cd maf_copilotkit/web
pnpm install && pnpm dev
cd tmp-ag-ui
pnpm install && pnpm build
pnpm test
pnpm lint
pnpm dev
```

Server: `POST /api/local_chat`, `POST /api/messages` (Teams), `GET /chat` (web UI), `/copilotkit` (AG-UI). `GRAPH_MODE=mock` (default) uses stubs; `GRAPH_MODE=live` requires Azure credentials for MS Graph.

Star-topology Handoff: Triage routes to 5 specialists (SharePoint, Meetings, Calendar, Documents, Project Info), who hand back when done. Triage (`maf/agents/triage.py`) has no tools. Workflow: `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py` (`HandoffBuilder`). Tools: `maf/tools/`, decorated with `<REDACTED_USER>(approval_mode="never_require")`, using `Annotated` params. Graph client: `maf/tools/graph_client.py` (lazy singleton, mock/live). Config: `maf/config.py` (`pydantic-settings`, `.env`). AG-UI bridge: `maf/agui_endpoint.py` (stateless; fresh workflow per request). Examples: `maf/agents/01_handoff/` through `05_magentic/`.

New tools go in `maf/tools/`, new agents in `maf/agents/`. New agents in the PM Copilot flow must be wired in `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py`. Never commit `.env` files or secrets. Python 3.10+, PEP 8, `agent-framework==1.0.0rc4`. Update `ANTIGRAVITY.md` if architectural changes are made. See `ANTIGRAVITY.md` for MAF upgrade procedures.
